inputs.OP:
loop: mov32 ds1[50], ds1[1]
.word /*ds1[50]*/ 0x0f010ae4
or ds0[48], ds0[48], ds1[50]
sub ds0[49], ds0[49], ds1[55]
tstz p0, ds0[49]
(p0) bra out
bra loop
out: nop
